title: Touch Interaction Update
changes: Added capability-based touch enhancements using pointer/coarse-input detection rather than phone/tablet device sniffing.
Added horizontal swipe switching between Journey and Japan Ready while keeping both visible tab buttons.
Added Campfire Recall swipe grading: right for I knew it and left for Didn't know; Almost remains a visible button.
Added long-press Japanese kana audio in Japan Ready and drag-to-answer support while preserving normal tap selection.
Added subtle supported-device haptics for Kotoba Rain catches and Kotoba Colosseum correct/wrong answers.
Increased touch target sizes and spacing on coarse-pointer devices without changing desktop sizing.
Kept Kotoba Rain direct finger tracking and made touch-game areas resist accidental text selection.
Retains all v11.5 Dashboard Clarity and v11.4 Adaptive Learning functionality.
Bumped release-controlled assets and service-worker caches to v11.6.0.
